name: Missha All Around Safe Block Aqua Sun SPF50+/PA++++ 50ml Sunscreen Cream
description:
Product Name: Missha All Around Safe Block Aqua Sun SPF50+/PA++++
Volume: 50ml
Origin: Made in Korea

Key Features

Moisture-Rich Formula: Water-type sunscreen that keeps skin hydrated

Mild & Soothing: Gentle ingredients suitable for sensitive skin

Lightweight Texture: Absorbs quickly, leaving skin fresh & non-sticky

Strong UV Protection: Broad-spectrum SPF50+ with PA++++ to protect against harmful UVA & UVB rays

Product Nature: Tube may appear half full, which is normal due to the formulation process
